verdict.rationale: MailerSend's own docs say it can parse and route incoming email using rules and webhooks, so the core capability is first-party and direct. The evidence is a single one-line marketing claim, with no detail on how rules work or which actions exist. Missing for 10: documented rule matching on recipient or pattern, forward and store actions, routing to multiple distinct POST endpoints, inbound payload/API docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can route inbound mail with rules — match on recipient or pattern and forward, store, or POST to different endpoints

citations.quote: Automatically parse and route incoming emails using rules and webhooks.
